mentions.name: Selecto
mentions.description: An open-source SQL query builder library for Elixir that works with or without Ecto, generating complex queries from clean, domain-based configs. Supports advanced joins, CTEs, subqueries, and analytics-friendly patterns, giving data-heavy apps SQL-level power without brittle hand-written query strings. Published on Hex.pm and looking for people to test and comment.
mentions.problem: Hand-written SQL query strings are brittle and hard to maintain in data-heavy apps.
